quizzes.title: Accounting Standards
quizzes.description: Learn what common accounting standards mean and what they cover. Simple definitions, with no calculations.

questions.question_text: What are accounting standards?
questions.explanation: The answer is Rules for preparing financial reports.

questions.question_text: Why do businesses use accounting standards?

answers.text: To make financial reports consistent and comparable

questions.explanation: The answer is To make financial reports consistent and comparable.

questions.question_text: What does IFRS stand for?
questions.explanation: The answer is International Financial Reporting Standards.

questions.question_text: What does IAS stand for in accounting?
questions.explanation: The answer is International Accounting Standards.

questions.question_text: What does GAAP stand for?
questions.explanation: The answer is Generally Accepted Accounting Principles.

questions.question_text: IAS 2 is about inventories. Which item is an example of inventory?

answers.text: Goods a shop keeps to sell

questions.explanation: The answer is Goods a shop keeps to sell.

questions.question_text: IAS 7 covers cash flow statements. What do they show?

answers.text: Cash coming in and going out

questions.explanation: The answer is Cash coming in and going out.

questions.question_text: IAS 16 covers property, plant and equipment. Which item fits?

answers.text: A machine used by a factory

questions.explanation: The answer is A machine used by a factory.

questions.question_text: IAS 38 covers intangible assets. Which asset has no physical form?
IAS 12 covers which topic?
IAS 19 covers employee benefits. Which item fits?
IFRS 15 covers revenue from customers. What is revenue?

answers.text: The colour of a company logo
The size of a car engine
Income earned from selling goods or services

questions.explanation: The answer is Income earned from selling goods or services.

questions.question_text: IFRS 16 covers leases. What is a lease?

answers.text: An agreement to use an asset for a period in return for payment

questions.explanation: The answer is An agreement to use an asset for a period in return for payment.

questions.question_text: IAS 36 covers impairment. What does impairment mean?

answers.text: An employee has changed their name
An asset has lost value below its recorded amount
A shop has changed its logo
A company has opened a website

questions.explanation: The answer is An asset has lost value below its recorded amount.

questions.question_text: IAS 40 covers investment property. Which example fits?

answers.text: A building held to earn rent

questions.explanation: The answer is A building held to earn rent.
